package student

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"mime"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
)

const maximumResponseBytes = 2 << 20

// Client reads bounded Student-owned action and mastery projections.
type Client struct {
	BaseURL                string
	InternalToken          string
	LearningWorkspaceToken string
	HTTPClient             *http.Client
}

type learningActionContextResponse struct {
	LearningActionID string                      `json:"learning_action_id"`
	StudentID        string                      `json:"student_id"`
	TaskID           string                      `json:"task_id"`
	ContextType      domain.LearningContextType  `json:"context_type"`
	ContextID        string                      `json:"context_id"`
	LearningTargets  []domain.LearningTargetRef  `json:"learning_targets"`
	Status           domain.LearningActionStatus `json:"status"`
	OpenedAt         time.Time                   `json:"opened_at"`
}

type targetMasteryResponse struct {
	Target                  domain.LearningTargetRef  `json:"target"`
	State                   domain.TargetMasteryState `json:"state"`
	MasteryScore            float64                   `json:"mastery_score"`
	Confidence              float64                   `json:"confidence"`
	IndependentSuccessCount int                       `json:"independent_success_count"`
	AssistedSuccessCount    int                       `json:"assisted_success_count"`
	FailureCount            int                       `json:"failure_count"`
	EvidenceCount           int                       `json:"evidence_count"`
	LastSeenAt              *time.Time                `json:"last_seen_at,omitempty"`
	LastPracticedAt         *time.Time                `json:"last_practiced_at,omitempty"`
	LastFailedAt            *time.Time                `json:"last_failed_at,omitempty"`
	PolicyVersion           string                    `json:"policy_version"`
}

type learnerOverviewOnboardingResponse struct {
	StudentID              string    `json:"student_id"`
	DirectionCode          string    `json:"direction_code"`
	SelfAssessedExperience string    `json:"self_assessed_experience"`
	KnownStacks            []string  `json:"known_stacks"`
	DesiredStacks          []string  `json:"desired_stacks"`
	GoalCode               string    `json:"goal_code"`
	GoalText               string    `json:"goal_text"`
	PreferredLanguage      string    `json:"preferred_language"`
	WeeklyMinutes          int       `json:"weekly_minutes"`
	PreferredPace          string    `json:"preferred_pace"`
	ProfileVersion         string    `json:"profile_version"`
	Version                int64     `json:"version"`
	CreatedAt              time.Time `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt              time.Time `json:"updated_at"`
}

type learnerOverviewMasteryResponse struct {
	StudentID string `json:"student_id"`
	targetMasteryResponse
}

func (client Client) GetLearnerOverview(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.StudentLearnerOverview, error) {
	endpoint, err := client.endpoint("/internal/students/" + url.PathEscape(studentID) + "/learner-overview")
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearnerOverview{}, err
	}
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, endpoint, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearnerOverview{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	client.authorize(request)
	response, err := client.do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearnerOverview{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		if response.StatusCode == http.StatusNotFound {
			return domain.StudentLearnerOverview{}, domain.ErrStudentContextNotFound
		}
		if response.StatusCode == http.StatusBadRequest {
			return domain.StudentLearnerOverview{}, domain.ErrInvalidStudentContext
		}
		return domain.StudentLearnerOverview{}, unavailableStatus(response.Status)
	}
	if !studentJSONMediaType(response.Header.Get("Content-Type")) {
		return domain.StudentLearnerOverview{}, invalidStudentResponse(domain.ErrInvalidStudentContext)
	}
	var payload struct {
		StudentID      string                             `json:"student_id"`
		Version        string                             `json:"version"`
		Onboarding     *learnerOverviewOnboardingResponse `json:"onboarding"`
		RecentMastery  []learnerOverviewMasteryResponse   `json:"recent_mastery"`
		LearningPath   *domain.StudentLearningPath        `json:"learning_path"`
		Diagnostic     *domain.StudentDiagnosticSnapshot  `json:"diagnostic"`
		RecentSessions []domain.StudentLearningSession    `json:"recent_sessions"`
	}
	if err := decodeStrict(response.Body, &payload); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearnerOverview{}, invalidStudentResponse(domain.ErrInvalidStudentContext)
	}
	overview := domain.StudentLearnerOverview{
		StudentID: payload.StudentID, Version: payload.Version, LearningPath: payload.LearningPath,
		Diagnostic: payload.Diagnostic, RecentSessions: payload.RecentSessions,
	}
	if payload.Onboarding != nil {
		if payload.Onboarding.StudentID != payload.StudentID {
			return domain.StudentLearnerOverview{}, domain.ErrInvalidStudentContext
		}
		overview.Onboarding = &domain.StudentOnboardingSnapshot{
			DirectionCode:          payload.Onboarding.DirectionCode,
			SelfAssessedExperience: payload.Onboarding.SelfAssessedExperience,
			KnownStacks:            payload.Onboarding.KnownStacks, DesiredStacks: payload.Onboarding.DesiredStacks,
			GoalCode: payload.Onboarding.GoalCode, GoalText: payload.Onboarding.GoalText,
			PreferredLanguage: payload.Onboarding.PreferredLanguage,
			WeeklyMinutes:     payload.Onboarding.WeeklyMinutes, PreferredPace: payload.Onboarding.PreferredPace,
			ProfileVersion: payload.Onboarding.ProfileVersion, Version: payload.Onboarding.Version,
		}
	}
	overview.RecentMastery = make([]domain.StudentTargetMastery, 0, len(payload.RecentMastery))
	for _, item := range payload.RecentMastery {
		if item.StudentID != payload.StudentID {
			return domain.StudentLearnerOverview{}, domain.ErrInvalidStudentContext
		}
		overview.RecentMastery = append(overview.RecentMastery, domain.StudentTargetMastery{
			Target: item.Target, State: item.State, MasteryScore: item.MasteryScore,
			Confidence: item.Confidence, IndependentSuccessCount: item.IndependentSuccessCount,
			AssistedSuccessCount: item.AssistedSuccessCount, FailureCount: item.FailureCount,
			EvidenceCount: item.EvidenceCount, LastSeenAt: item.LastSeenAt,
			LastPracticedAt: item.LastPracticedAt, LastFailedAt: item.LastFailedAt,
			PolicyVersion: item.PolicyVersion,
		})
	}
	return overview, nil
}

func (client Client) GetLearningSession(ctx context.Context, studentID, sessionID string) (domain.StudentLearningSession, error) {
	endpoint, err := client.endpoint("/internal/students/" + url.PathEscape(studentID) + "/learning-sessions/" + url.PathEscape(sessionID))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningSession{}, err
	}
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, endpoint, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningSession{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	client.authorize(request)
	response, err := client.do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningSession{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		if response.StatusCode == http.StatusNotFound {
			return domain.StudentLearningSession{}, domain.ErrStudentContextNotFound
		}
		if response.StatusCode == http.StatusBadRequest {
			return domain.StudentLearningSession{}, domain.ErrInvalidStudentContext
		}
		return domain.StudentLearningSession{}, unavailableStatus(response.Status)
	}
	var session domain.StudentLearningSession
	if err := decodeStrict(response.Body, &session); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningSession{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	normalized, err := domain.NormalizeStudentLearningSessions([]domain.StudentLearningSession{session}, studentID)
	if err != nil || normalized[0].ID != strings.TrimSpace(sessionID) {
		return domain.StudentLearningSession{}, domain.ErrInvalidStudentContext
	}
	return normalized[0], nil
}

func (client Client) ApplyLearningSessionMetrics(
	ctx context.Context,
	studentID, sessionID string,
	expectedVersion int64,
	analytics domain.LearningAnalyticsSummary,
) (domain.StudentLearningSession, error) {
	body, err := json.Marshal(struct {
		ExpectedVersion          int64  `json:"expected_version"`
		AnalyticsSessionID       string `json:"analytics_session_id"`
		ActiveLearningSeconds    int    `json:"active_learning_seconds"`
		LessonCount              int    `json:"lesson_count"`
		TaskCount                int    `json:"task_count"`
		QuestionCount            int    `json:"question_count"`
		SelectedExplanationCount int    `json:"selected_explanation_count"`
		CodeRunCount             int    `json:"code_run_count"`
		FailureCount             int    `json:"failure_count"`
		PassedTestCount          int    `json:"passed_test_count"`
		HintCount                int    `json:"hint_count"`
		TeacherInterventionCount int    `json:"teacher_intervention_count"`
		StuckSignalCount         int    `json:"stuck_signal_count"`
	}{
		ExpectedVersion: expectedVersion, AnalyticsSessionID: analytics.AnalyticsSessionID,
		ActiveLearningSeconds: analytics.ActiveLearningSeconds, LessonCount: analytics.LessonCount,
		TaskCount: analytics.TaskCount, QuestionCount: analytics.QuestionCount,
		SelectedExplanationCount: analytics.SelectedExplanationCount, CodeRunCount: analytics.CodeRunCount,
		FailureCount: analytics.FailureCount, PassedTestCount: analytics.PassedTestCount,
		HintCount: analytics.HintCount, TeacherInterventionCount: analytics.TeacherInterventionCount,
		StuckSignalCount: analytics.StuckSignalCount,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningSession{}, domain.ErrInvalidStudentContext
	}
	endpoint, err := client.endpoint("/internal/students/" + url.PathEscape(studentID) + "/learning-sessions/" + url.PathEscape(sessionID) + "/metrics")
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningSession{}, err
	}
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPut, endpoint, bytes.NewReader(body))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningSession{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	client.authorize(request)
	response, err := client.do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningSession{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		switch response.StatusCode {
		case http.StatusNotFound:
			return domain.StudentLearningSession{}, domain.ErrStudentContextNotFound
		case http.StatusBadRequest:
			return domain.StudentLearningSession{}, domain.ErrInvalidStudentContext
		case http.StatusConflict:
			return domain.StudentLearningSession{}, domain.ErrTeacherGenerationConflict
		default:
			return domain.StudentLearningSession{}, unavailableStatus(response.Status)
		}
	}
	var session domain.StudentLearningSession
	if err := decodeStrict(response.Body, &session); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningSession{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	normalized, err := domain.NormalizeStudentLearningSessions([]domain.StudentLearningSession{session}, studentID)
	if err != nil || normalized[0].ID != strings.TrimSpace(sessionID) || normalized[0].Version != expectedVersion+1 ||
		normalized[0].AnalyticsSessionID != analytics.AnalyticsSessionID {
		return domain.StudentLearningSession{}, domain.ErrInvalidStudentContext
	}
	return normalized[0], nil
}

func (client Client) GetLearningActionContext(
	ctx context.Context,
	studentID string,
	learningActionID string,
) (domain.StudentLearningActionSnapshot, error) {
	endpoint, err := client.endpoint(
		"/internal/students/" + url.PathEscape(studentID) +
			"/learning-actions/" + url.PathEscape(learningActionID) + "/context",
	)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningActionSnapshot{}, err
	}
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, endpoint, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningActionSnapshot{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	client.authorize(request)
	response, err := client.do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningActionSnapshot{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		if response.StatusCode == http.StatusNotFound {
			return domain.StudentLearningActionSnapshot{}, domain.ErrStudentContextNotFound
		}
		if response.StatusCode == http.StatusBadRequest {
			return domain.StudentLearningActionSnapshot{}, domain.ErrInvalidStudentContext
		}
		return domain.StudentLearningActionSnapshot{}, unavailableStatus(response.Status)
	}
	var payload learningActionContextResponse
	if err := decodeStrict(response.Body, &payload); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningActionSnapshot{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	return domain.StudentLearningActionSnapshot{
		LearningActionID: payload.LearningActionID,
		StudentID:        payload.StudentID,
		TaskID:           payload.TaskID,
		ContextType:      payload.ContextType,
		ContextID:        payload.ContextID,
		LearningTargets:  payload.LearningTargets,
		Status:           payload.Status,
		OpenedAt:         payload.OpenedAt,
	}, nil
}

func (client Client) GetLearningActionCodeContext(
	ctx context.Context,
	studentID string,
	learningActionID string,
) (domain.StudentLearningActionCodeContext, error) {
	endpoint, err := client.endpoint(
		"/internal/students/" + url.PathEscape(studentID) +
			"/learning-actions/" + url.PathEscape(learningActionID) + "/code-context",
	)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningActionCodeContext{}, err
	}
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, endpoint, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningActionCodeContext{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	client.authorize(request)
	response, err := client.do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningActionCodeContext{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		switch response.StatusCode {
		case http.StatusNotFound:
			return domain.StudentLearningActionCodeContext{}, domain.ErrStudentContextNotFound
		case http.StatusConflict:
			return domain.StudentLearningActionCodeContext{}, domain.ErrLearningActionClosed
		case http.StatusBadRequest:
			return domain.StudentLearningActionCodeContext{}, domain.ErrInvalidStudentContext
		default:
			return domain.StudentLearningActionCodeContext{}, unavailableStatus(response.Status)
		}
	}
	var result domain.StudentLearningActionCodeContext
	if err := decodeStrict(response.Body, &result); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningActionCodeContext{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	result, err = domain.NormalizeStudentLearningActionCodeContext(result, studentID, learningActionID, result.TaskID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningActionCodeContext{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (client Client) GetTargetMastery(
	ctx context.Context,
	studentID string,
	targets []domain.LearningTargetRef,
) ([]domain.StudentTargetMastery, error) {
	if len(targets) == 0 || len(targets) > 100 {
		return nil, domain.ErrInvalidStudentContext
	}
	requestBody, err := json.Marshal(struct {
		Targets []domain.LearningTargetRef `json:"targets"`
	}{Targets: targets})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrInvalidStudentContext
	}
	endpoint, err := client.endpoint("/internal/students/" + url.PathEscape(studentID) + "/mastery/query")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, endpoint, bytes.NewReader(requestBody))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, unavailable(err)
	}
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	client.authorize(request)
	response, err := client.do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		if response.StatusCode == http.StatusBadRequest {
			return nil, domain.ErrInvalidStudentContext
		}
		return nil, unavailableStatus(response.Status)
	}
	var payload struct {
		Items []targetMasteryResponse `json:"items"`
	}
	if err := decodeStrict(response.Body, &payload); err != nil {
		return nil, unavailable(err)
	}
	result := make([]domain.StudentTargetMastery, 0, len(payload.Items))
	for _, item := range payload.Items {
		result = append(result, domain.StudentTargetMastery{
			Target:                  item.Target,
			State:                   item.State,
			MasteryScore:            item.MasteryScore,
			Confidence:              item.Confidence,
			IndependentSuccessCount: item.IndependentSuccessCount,
			AssistedSuccessCount:    item.AssistedSuccessCount,
			FailureCount:            item.FailureCount,
			EvidenceCount:           item.EvidenceCount,
			LastSeenAt:              item.LastSeenAt,
			LastPracticedAt:         item.LastPracticedAt,
			LastFailedAt:            item.LastFailedAt,
			PolicyVersion:           item.PolicyVersion,
		})
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (client Client) endpoint(path string) (string, error) {
	return client.endpointWithToken(path, client.InternalToken)
}

func (client Client) endpointWithToken(path, token string) (string, error) {
	baseURL := strings.TrimRight(strings.TrimSpace(client.BaseURL), "/")
	if baseURL == "" || strings.TrimSpace(token) == "" {
		return "", unavailable(errors.New("student service URL and internal token are required"))
	}
	parsed, err := url.ParseRequestURI(baseURL + path)
	if err != nil || parsed.Scheme == "" || parsed.Host == "" {
		return "", unavailable(errors.New("invalid student service URL"))
	}
	return parsed.String(), nil
}

func (client Client) authorize(request *http.Request) {
	client.authorizeWithToken(request, client.InternalToken)
}

func (client Client) authorizeWithToken(request *http.Request, token string) {
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", token)
}

func (client Client) do(request *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	httpClient := client.HTTPClient
	if httpClient == nil {
		httpClient = &http.Client{Timeout: 3 * time.Second}
	}
	noRedirect := *httpClient
	noRedirect.CheckRedirect = func(*http.Request, []*http.Request) error { return http.ErrUseLastResponse }
	response, err := noRedirect.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, unavailable(err)
	}
	return response, nil
}

func decodeStrict(reader io.Reader, target any) error {
	limited := &io.LimitedReader{R: reader, N: maximumResponseBytes + 1}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(limited)
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return errors.New("student response must contain one JSON value")
	}
	if limited.N == 0 {
		return errors.New("student response exceeds size limit")
	}
	return nil
}

func unavailable(cause error) error {
	return fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable, cause)
}

func invalidStudentResponse(cause error) error {
	return fmt.Errorf("%w: %w", domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable, cause)
}

func studentJSONMediaType(value string) bool {
	mediaType, _, err := mime.ParseMediaType(value)
	return err == nil && mediaType == "application/json"
}

func unavailableStatus(status string) error {
	return fmt.Errorf("%w: unexpected student response %s", domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable, status)
}

var _ repository.StudentLearningActionContextReader = Client{}
var _ repository.StudentLearningActionCodeContextReader = Client{}
var _ repository.StudentTargetMasteryReader = Client{}
var _ repository.StudentLearnerOverviewReader = Client{}
var _ repository.StudentLearningSessionGateway = Client{}
var _ repository.StudentLearningWorkspaceReader = Client{}
